resources.string: A temporary archive may remain on the computer: %1$s. Check and remove it when no archive operation is running.
Creating a ZIP needs free space in the remote source folder for a full archive. If the agent cannot start it, files will be copied individually. Incomplete local folders keep a .partial suffix.
This provider could not retain access for the queue. Choose a different location.
The archive is damaged, incomplete or exceeds the supported structure limits.
The selected item changed. Refresh the folder and confirm the selection again.
This server does not identify symbolic links or special files in SFTP listings. Unverifiable files are reported by path; a disconnected queue pauses. Incomplete folders remain marked .partial.
No access to folder: %1$s. The rest of the queue continues.
The local Android document could not be written or read back. The file session is still connected; retry this item.
This provider cannot rename documents. Some files keep the .partial suffix; rename them in Android Files.
Already deleted: %1$s. The remaining selection was not deleted; refresh the folder and confirm again.
Recursive folder deletion follows symbolic links and junctions. Targets outside the selected folder can be erased too; check the folder in MeshCentral before confirming.
